story: Cathedral Caverns State Park is a 493-acre public recreation area and natural history preserve in Kennamer Cove, Alabama, featuring a karst cave with a large stalagmite forest. It was declared a National Natural Landmark in 1972 and opened as a state park in 2000.
matters: The park protects a significant cave system that includes Mystery River and an entrance measuring 25 feet tall and 128 feet wide.
